dimensions.name: Autonomous orchestration
dimensions.blocker: The canonical website capability, approvals, budgets, Build Room and recovery paths are now integrated, but the deployed synthetic website journey still required a dense incident-and-repair cycle and the wider workforce lacks approved execution adapters for several real provider writes. Live payment and outbound delivery also remain intentionally disabled.

dimensions.name: Operational reliability
dimensions.blocker: Revision :102 is healthy and rollback-proven, but the deployed synthetic website journey exposed wake delivery, bounded-repair, validator/reviewer and process-loss recovery defects through PR #198. Those fixes are merged, yet a verified database restore drill, external 5xx/task-health alarms, edge throttling and whole-company deletion also remain incomplete.

dimensions.name: Premium website-generation capability
dimensions.blocker: SelfOperate now has a signed, budget-bounded Stromation website capability and a deployed synthetic journey, removing yesterday's integration gap. But that journey remains paused and unpublished before the production/full-build handoff after multiple live repair and recovery defects, so repeatable premium unattended delivery is not yet proven.

dimensions.name: Customer acquisition readiness
dimensions.blocker: The public offer, SEO/GEO surface, package-specific intake and founder control experience are much stronger, but there is still no demonstrated repeatable lead-to-checkout-to-paid funnel. Live Stripe remains parked on the Texas tax permit, so conversion economics and channel efficiency cannot yet be proven.

dimensions.name: Business / economic proof
dimensions.blocker: There is still no verified paying SelfOperate/Business Builder cohort, recurring revenue, CAC, gross margin, retention or paid-delivery economics. Product-completion and synthetic-journey progress do not substitute for economic proof.

changed: The biggest change is that yesterday's largest product gap is gone: SelfOperate now has a canonical signed, budget-bounded website capability into Stromation, with exact founder approvals, Build Room projection, package boundaries and a deployed synthetic paid journey. At the same time the product-completion release is live on revision :102 with the nine-role workforce, Founder Actions and Ownership Vault, operating intelligence, canonical customer lifecycle, Customers workspace and bounded read-only CRM sync. This materially raises fulfillment, website capability, technical maturity and commercial readiness. The counterweight is operational: that synthetic website journey exposed a dense chain of production-only wake, repair-scope, validator/reviewer and process-loss defects through PR #198 and remains paused before the production/full-build handoff, so reliability is marked down despite the fixes.
method: Business Builder/SelfOperate-only independent forecast grounded in the 2026-09-22 canonical dariusstrongman/businessbuilder main and deployed revision :102, product-completion PRs #62-69, the merged SelfOperate website capability and its deployed synthetic paid-journey evidence, directly relevant Stromation fixes through PR #198 plus the prior Phase 6-6.6 quality evidence, current Stripe/tax-permit state, and explicit Business Builder customer/revenue evidence. Merged implementation is distinguished from deployed/live proof, and external provider/legal gates are not treated as completed engineering. Unrelated Stromation ventures, company-wide autonomy and Stromation customer/revenue status are excluded. Forward-looking values are estimates, not guarantees.
